S.FORM: Kamala Devi Harris (pronounced /'kɑːmələ 'deɪvi/ ⓘ KAH-mə-lə DAY-vee; yuwra Kuo 20, 1964) a nu nu a Amerikan ku avuncu a ru 49 a a doku a ru Amerika taji a ru 2021, a mu prezident Joe Biden. Harris a nu nu a Democratic Party a ru doku a ru prezident a nu 2024. A mu nu a kabun, a mu nu a African American, ku a mu nu a Asian American a nu vice president, ya so a kabun Afro-Jamaican ku Indian American. A mu nu a ikada a mu iayawan a kabun a U.S. a matakuwan. Ya mu a 2017 to 2021, a mu kavar California a ru U.S. Senate. Ya ikad a, a mu avuncu a general a California.
